title: 5-year-old girl killed, mother hurt in Sultan Kudarat road accident

blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — A five-year-old girl was killed and her mother was injured after a vehicle failed to climb an uphill road and rolled backward, hitting them in Bagumbayan town, Sultan Kudarat, on Saturday afternoon, Oct. 10, police said. The Bagumbayan Municipal Police Station reported that the accident occurred around 4:30 p.m. in Purok Sambag, Barangay South Sepaka. Based on the initial investigation, a white Midi Gratour driven by Jerry Jisim Requiso, a resident of Alabel, Sarangani, was traveling uphill when its engine suddenly stopped.
